mentions.name: Find a Conference
mentions.description: A web app that helps people decide which cybersecurity conferences are worth attending. It maintains a curated conference list whose details are partially AI-sourced but human-validated, and has reached MVP stage with early organic traffic.
mentions.problem: A friend needed to decide which cybersecurity conferences are worth going to.
mentions.source_excerpt: A friend needed to decide which cybersecurity conferences are worth going to, so I started building Find a Conference (https://app.findaconference.net).
mentions.author: potentural
